Method of Attack: Ransomware encryptor targeting VMware ESXi virtual machines
Linux encryptor using AES to encrypt files and elliptic-curve cryptography (ECC) to encrypt decryption keys
Uses VMware ESXi and VMware vCenter command-line utilities to list and cleanly shut down running VMs before encryption
Command-line interface allowing affiliates to customize attack features such as file size to encrypt, stopping running VMs, wiping free space
Attack Vector: Ransomware-as-a-Service operation promoted on RAMP hacking forums
